name: Shakerz Imst
kurzbeschreibung:
**Shakerz Imst** in **Imst** – where the mountains meet the beat!

Discover the ultimate **Tirol** vibe in this legendary club, right in the heart of **Imst**. Whether you're into electronic beats, hip-hop, or just love dancing under the stars, **Shakerz** has something for everyone.

🎶 **Live music** and DJ sets keep the energy high, while the cozy atmosphere makes you feel right at home.
🍻 Enjoy a cold drink or a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** breakfast the next morning—because after a night of fun, you deserve it!

📍 **Location:** **Imst**, **Tirol** – your gateway to unforgettable nights in the Alps.

Come for the music, stay for the memories! 🚀✨
